note: Entirely fictional regression cases for issue #93. Identifier tokens are not bank-declared payment failures. These cases do not verify new bank formats for automatic saving.

cases.name: failure word in UPI local part is not failed status
cases.body: INR 12.34 debited from A/c XX1234 to merchant.failed@examplebank (UPI Ref No 123456789012)

cases.name: failure word in UPI handle is not failed status
cases.body: INR 12.34 credited to A/c XX1234 from payer@declined (UPI Ref No 123456789012)

cases.name: multiple mixed-case VPAs do not manufacture failure wording
cases.body: INR 12.34 debited from A/c XX1234 from payer@Unsuccessful to Merchant.Declined@examplebank (UPI Ref No 123456789012)

cases.name: explicit failed wording survives identifier exclusion
cases.body: UPI payment of INR 12.34 debited from A/c XX1234 to merchant.failed@examplebank failed. Amount will be reversed.

cases.name: explicit declined wording after two VPAs remains failed
cases.body: INR 12.34 debited from A/c XX1234 from payer@failed to merchant@unsuccessful; transaction declined.

cases.name: future debit with failure word in VPA stays a reminder
cases.body: INR 12.34 will be debited from A/c XX1234 to merchant.failed@examplebank tomorrow.

cases.name: unsupported HDFC shape with a failure word remains reviewed and posted
cases.body: Credit Alert! INR 12.34 credited to HDFC Bank A/c XX1234 on 01-10-26 from VPA merchant.failed@examplebank (UPI 12345678xxxx)

cases.name: HDFC lookalike with VPA marker and explicit failure remains failed
cases.body: Credit Alert! INR 12.34 credited to HDFC Bank A/c XX1234 on 01-10-26 from VPA merchant.failed@examplebank (UPI 123456789012). Transaction could not be processed.
